title: German Paneer Casserole
description: A creamy, savory casserole featuring paneer cheese and unique flavor profiles.
instructions: Sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the German sausage and cook until browned.
Add the unique mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid.
Stir in creme fraiche and bring to a simmer.
Add the paneer cheese and stir until melted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with chopped parsley.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown and bubbly.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
